QuestInfo.name: Stolen Child 2
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wings have shown their true colors! Confront #b#p2154002#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002# tells you to go through the #bPower Plant Entrance#k at #bPower Plant Security#k to the right. This time she means it. You can trust her, right?
QuestInfo.2: You defeated #p1033230#, one of the Black Mage's commanders. At least the kid was okay. You should get him to the village quickly.

0.0: Oh, you're so serious! I love it. Fabulous! I'd keep you for myself, but SHE will get mad at me if I keep you any longer, so I guess I'll send you her way...
0.1: Take the portal to the right and watch out for #bPower Plant Security#k. From there, you'll see an #bentrance to the Power Plant#k. Your little Elven urchin is there. But don't yell at him like you yelled at me. He might cry.

no.0: I'm telling the truth this time! Honest!

npc.0: Take the portal to the right and go to #bPower Plant Security#k. You'll see the #bPower Plant entrance#k there. The kid will be waiting for you, and so will she.
